name: Academy of Notre Dame de Namur Summer Camps
operator_name: Academy of Notre Dame de Namur
description_short: Short sports and enrichment camps for girls at the Academy of Notre Dame de Namur in Villanova, mostly half day and four days long. Coaches run basketball, field hockey, lacrosse, soccer, volleyball and learn to row camps, and there is a dance intensive and a middle school leadership program with a ropes course and public speaking.
refund_policy_summary: No full refunds: 80% through April 1, 2026, 50% April 2 to May 1, none after May 1; no proration for partial attendance.

sessions.name: Dance Intensive, second week if the first fills (grades 4 to 12)
Learn to Row (grades 7 to 9, Hines Rowing Center)
Middle School Volleyball Camp, evenings (grades 5 to 8)
High School Field Hockey Camp (grades 9 to 12)

notes: 2026 camps, all open to the public. Most run mornings or 9 am to 2 pm. Soccer and volleyball prices were not shown on the page. A CPR and First Aid course (June 22 and 23, grades 7 to 12, $125) is left out of the sessions. Learn to Row meets at Hines Rowing Center in Conshohocken. Future Stars also runs a day camp (ages 5 to 13) and STEM camp on the campus, registered through Future Stars; not covered by this listing. Ages are derived from grades 1 to 12. 2027 not posted yet.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Summer Camp Offerings page: each camp's grades, dates, times and cost, refund policy, camp contact; ages derived from grades 1 to 12. The school describes itself as an all girls Catholic academy.

source.title: Private School Summer Camps - Academy of Notre Dame de Namur

changes: Town added to cities.py from the Census 2024 Gazetteer, so the city validates.
for_andrew: These are a dozen separate sports and enrichment camps, most four mornings long and two of them two or three days, sharing one campus and page. I made one listing with each camp as a session. List it this way, or drop it as a set of clinics?

Future Stars runs a separate day camp (ages 5 to 13) and a STEM camp on this campus, registered through futurestars.com. Should that be its own listing from Future Stars' page, like the Future Stars draft at Villanova's Cabrini campus?
